intro: A sound of its own for the Crystal Crawler's turn (2026-11-13). It walks round its pillar and twists at every corner, every few seconds, and until now it played the stone creak that a dozen other things play too (cracked ground, heavy plates, the skeletons' rattle), loud. Three short Magnific ideas, three takes each (the game picks one at random each turn), quieter than the creak; "Now" is the creak it played before, and Keep silent gives the turn no sound. Press Repeat to hear an option several times at the crawler's pace. The game plays Crystal ticks meanwhile. Pick one, or choose Neither and say how it should sound.
